maddeler.e:
استصبروا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْبَرُوا (istaṣbarū) /is.tasˤ.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اُسْتُصْبِرُوا (ustuṣbirū) /us.tusˤ.bi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اِسْتَصْبِرُوا (istaṣbirū) /is.tasˤ.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
